#--------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate a per-variant build_info.inc that embeds the CPP options and
# the (best-effort) link line into the binary, reproducing the classic
# makefile feature exposed via `vasp_std -c` and `vasp_std -l`.
#
# Written to ${out_dir}/build_info.inc at configure time. build_info.F is
# then preprocessed from a copy placed in ${out_dir} so that its
# `#include "build_info.inc"` resolves to this generated file (the
# current-file directory takes precedence for quoted includes) instead of
# the `Unknown` placeholder shipped in src/build_info.inc.
#--------------------------------------------------------------------
# Recursively resolve a list of link items (CMake targets + raw flags) into
# actual linker arguments (library file paths, -l/-L flags, link options).
# Imported/interface targets are walked via IMPORTED_LOCATION,
# INTERFACE_LINK_OPTIONS and INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES. A GLOBAL "visited"
# property guards against cycles and duplicates; reset it before each
# top-level call. This is informational only, so it must never hard-error:
# location reads are restricted to imported targets (see CMP0026 below).
function(_vasp_resolve_link_items out_var)
  set(_out "")
  foreach(_item IN LISTS ARGN)
    if(NOT _item)
      continue()
    endif()
    # unwrap a single simple generator expression: $<COND:payload> -> payload
    # (CMake regex needs [$] for a literal '$'; \$ does not match)
    string(REGEX REPLACE "^[$]<[^:]*:(.+)>$" "\\1" _item "${_item}")
    # give up on anything still carrying genex/export markers we can't resolve
    if(_item MATCHES "[$]<" OR _item MATCHES "::@")
      continue()
    endif()
    if(TARGET ${_item})
      get_property(_visited GLOBAL PROPERTY _vasp_bi_visited)
      if(_item IN_LIST _visited)
        continue()
      endif()
      set_property(GLOBAL APPEND PROPERTY _vasp_bi_visited ${_item})
      # the actual library file, if this is an imported library. Only imported
      # targets may be queried for a location: reading LOCATION from an in-tree
      # target is a hard error (CMP0026), so those keep their target name -
      # just like the in-tree object libraries below.
      set(_loc "")
      get_target_property(_imported ${_item} IMPORTED)
      get_target_property(_type ${_item} TYPE)
      if(_imported)
        foreach(_p IMPORTED_LOCATION IMPORTED_LOCATION_RELEASE
                   IMPORTED_LOCATION_RELWITHDEBINFO IMPORTED_LOCATION_NOCONFIG)
          get_target_property(_tmp ${_item} ${_p})
          if(_tmp AND NOT _loc)
            set(_loc "${_tmp}")
          endif()
        endforeach()
      elseif(NOT _type STREQUAL "INTERFACE_LIBRARY")
        get_target_property(_alias ${_item} ALIASED_TARGET)
        if(_alias)
          set(_loc "${_alias}")
        else()
          set(_loc "${_item}")
        endif()
      endif()
      if(_loc)
        list(APPEND _out "${_loc}")
      endif()
      get_target_property(_opts ${_item} INTERFACE_LINK_OPTIONS)
      if(_opts)
        foreach(_o IN LISTS _opts)
          if(NOT _o MATCHES "[$]<")  # drop link options we can't resolve
            string(REGEX REPLACE "^SHELL:" "" _o "${_o}")  # CMake-only marker
            list(APPEND _out "${_o}")
          endif()
        endforeach()
      endif()
      get_target_property(_deps ${_item} INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES)
      if(_deps)
        _vasp_resolve_link_items(_sub ${_deps})
        list(APPEND _out ${_sub})
      endif()
    else()
      # raw string: a path or a -l/-L/-Wl,... flag
      list(APPEND _out "${_item}")
    endif()
  endforeach()
  set(${out_var} "${_out}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

function(vasp_generate_build_info name pp_defs out_dir)
  # helper: emit a Fortran continued string literal from a token list,
  # matching the classic makefile layout:   lhs = '&\n&tok1 &\n...&tokN'
  macro(_bi_emit out_var lhs)
    set(_tokens ${ARGN})
    list(LENGTH _tokens _n)
    set(${out_var} "    character(len=*), parameter :: ${lhs} = '&\n")
    set(_i 0)
    foreach(_t IN LISTS _tokens)
      math(EXPR _i "${_i}+1")
      # the .inc is a single-quoted Fortran string, so embedded double
      # quotes are literal and the command-line backslash-escaping is dropped
      string(REPLACE "\\\"" "\"" _t "${_t}")
      if(_i LESS _n)
        string(APPEND ${out_var} "&${_t} &\n")
      else()
        string(APPEND ${out_var} "&${_t}'\n")
      endif()
    endforeach()
    if(_n EQUAL 0)
      string(APPEND ${out_var} "&Unknown'\n")
    endif()
  endmacro()

  # cpp_options keeps its own (slightly different) classic layout where the
  # closing quote sits on its own continuation line.
  set(_cpp "    character(len=*), parameter :: cpp_options = '&\n")
  foreach(_d IN LISTS pp_defs)
    string(REPLACE "\\\"" "\"" _d "${_d}")
    string(APPEND _cpp "&${_d} &\n")
  endforeach()
  string(APPEND _cpp "    &'\n")

  # components of the link line. External libs are CMake (often imported)
  # targets; resolve them to the real library paths / -l / -L flags. The
  # in-tree object libraries (linpack/lib/parser) have no standalone file and
  # are kept as their target names.
  set(_fc "${CMAKE_Fortran_COMPILER}")
  set(_linker_flags ${VASP_FORTRAN_LINKER_FLAGS} ${VASP_OFFLOAD_LINK_FLAGS})
  set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY _vasp_bi_visited "")
  _vasp_resolve_link_items(_ext_resolved ${VASP_EXTERNAL_LIBS} ${VASP_OFFLOAD_LIBS})
  set(_libs linpack_objects lib_objects parser_objects ${_ext_resolved})

  _bi_emit(_link "link_line " ${_fc} ${_linker_flags} ${_libs})
  _bi_emit(_fc_s "fc    " ${_fc})
  _bi_emit(_fcl_s "fcl   " ${_fc} ${_linker_flags})
  _bi_emit(_ff "fflags" ${VASP_FORTRAN_FLAGS} ${VASP_OFFLOAD_FLAGS} ${CMAKE_Fortran_FLAGS})
  _bi_emit(_ll "llibs " ${_libs})
  _bi_emit(_in "incs  " ${PREPROCESSOR_INCLUDE_FLAGS})

  file(WRITE "${out_dir}/build_info.inc"
    "${_cpp}${_link}${_fc_s}${_fcl_s}${_ff}${_ll}${_in}")
endfunction()

function(vasp_create_executable name sources)
  # preprocessing all sources
  set(PREPROCESSED_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${name}")
  file(MAKE_DIRECTORY ${PREPROCESSED_DIR})

  # now we have to add the PP options incl vasp version specific ones
  set(PP_DEF_${name} "${PREPROCESSOR_DEFINITIONS}")
  if (${name} STREQUAL "vasp_std")
    list(APPEND PP_DEF_${name} "-DNGZhalf")
  endif()
  if (${name} STREQUAL "vasp_gam")
    list(APPEND PP_DEF_${name} "-DNGZhalf")
    list(APPEND PP_DEF_${name} "-DwNGZhalf")
  endif()
  # Add custom command to run preprocessor
  # without this problems occur with:
  # file dependencies, empty module files, intel oneapi 2025 (no option to pass fpp options)
  # this also cleanly separates the pp part from the build part
  foreach(SOURCE_FILE ${sources})
    get_filename_component(FILE_NAME ${SOURCE_FILE} NAME_WE)
    set(PREPROCESSED_FILE ${PREPROCESSED_DIR}/${FILE_NAME}.f90)

    if(SOURCE_FILE STREQUAL "build_info.F")
      # Embed the real CPP/link/build info: generate the per-variant
      # build_info.inc, then preprocess a copy of build_info.F that lives
      # next to it so the quoted #include picks up the generated file.
      vasp_generate_build_info(${name} "${PP_DEF_${name}}" ${PREPROCESSED_DIR})
      set(_bi_copy ${PREPROCESSED_DIR}/build_info.F)
      add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT ${PREPROCESSED_FILE}
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
                ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/build_info.F ${_bi_copy}
        COMMAND ${FPP_COMMAND} ${PP_DEF_${name}} ${PREPROCESSOR_INCLUDE_FLAGS} ${_bi_copy} > ${PREPROCESSED_FILE}
        DEPENDS ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/build_info.F ${PREPROCESSED_DIR}/build_info.inc
        COMMENT "Preprocessing build_info.F (with embedded build info) for ${name}"
      )
      list(APPEND PREPROCESSED_SOURCES ${PREPROCESSED_FILE})
      continue()
    endif()

    add_custom_command(
      OUTPUT ${PREPROCESSED_FILE}
      COMMAND ${FPP_COMMAND} ${PP_DEF_${name}} ${PREPROCESSOR_INCLUDE_FLAGS} ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/${SOURCE_FILE} > ${PREPROCESSED_FILE}
      DEPENDS ${SOURCE_FILE}
      COMMENT "Preprocessing ${SOURCE_FILE}"
    )

    list(APPEND PREPROCESSED_SOURCES ${PREPROCESSED_FILE})
  endforeach()

  # run preprocessing before compiling
  add_custom_target(${name}_pp DEPENDS ${PREPROCESSED_SOURCES})

  # Warning suppression has to be applied per source, not target wide: -w (and
  # Intel's -w0) inhibit every diagnostic and no later -Wall/-Wextra can undo
  # that, so while they sit in VASP_FORTRAN_FLAGS the warning flags in
  # VASP_OFLAG_DEB have no effect at all.  Take them out of the target flags
  # here and re-apply them below to every source that is not being debugged.
  set(_target_fortran_flags ${VASP_FORTRAN_FLAGS})
  set(_quiet_flags)
  foreach(_flag -w -w0)
    if("${_flag}" IN_LIST VASP_FORTRAN_FLAGS)
      list(APPEND _quiet_flags ${_flag})
      list(REMOVE_ITEM _target_fortran_flags ${_flag})
    endif()
  endforeach()

  # set optimization flags
  foreach(pp_source ${PREPROCESSED_SOURCES})
    get_filename_component(source ${pp_source} NAME_WE)
    set(_debug_source FALSE)

    # Set default optimization flag based on build type
    if(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "Debug")
      set(_opt_flag ${VASP_OFLAG_DEB})
      set(_debug_source TRUE)
    else()
      set(_opt_flag ${VASP_OFLAG_DEFAULT})
      if(${source}.F IN_LIST VASP_SOURCES_O3)
        set(_opt_flag ${VASP_OFLAG_O3})
      endif()
      if(${source}.F IN_LIST VASP_SOURCES_O2)
        set(_opt_flag ${VASP_OFLAG_O2})
      endif()
      if(${source}.F IN_LIST VASP_SOURCES_O1)
        set(_opt_flag ${VASP_OFLAG_O1})
      endif()
      if(${source}.F IN_LIST VASP_SOURCES_IN)
        set(_opt_flag ${VASP_OFLAG_IN})
      endif()
      if(${source}.F IN_LIST VASP_SOURCES_DEB)
        if(${name} STREQUAL "vasp_std")
          message(STATUS "debugging for ${source} enabled. Flags: ${VASP_OFLAG_DEB}")
        endif()
        set(_opt_flag ${VASP_OFLAG_DEB})
        set(_debug_source TRUE)
      endif()
      if(${source}.F STREQUAL "main.F")
        # main.F keeps its own flags even when marked for debugging, so it also
        # keeps the warning suppression the rest of the build uses.
        set(_opt_flag ${VASP_OFLAG_MAIN})
        set(_debug_source FALSE)
      endif()
    endif()

    if(NOT _debug_source)
      list(APPEND _opt_flag ${_quiet_flags})
    endif()

    list(JOIN _opt_flag " " _opt_flag_str) # convert list to string
    set_source_files_properties(${pp_source} PROPERTIES COMPILE_FLAGS ${_opt_flag_str})
  endforeach()

  # now create the actual target
  add_executable(${name} ${PREPROCESSED_SOURCES})

  target_compile_options(${name} PRIVATE $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:Fortran>:${_target_fortran_flags}>)
  if(VASP_OFFLOAD_FLAGS)
    target_compile_options(${name} PRIVATE $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:Fortran>:${VASP_OFFLOAD_FLAGS}>)
  endif()
  target_link_options(${name} PRIVATE $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:Fortran>:${VASP_FORTRAN_LINKER_FLAGS}>)
  target_link_libraries(${name} PRIVATE linpack_objects lib_objects parser_objects ${VASP_EXTERNAL_LIBS})
  if(VASP_OFFLOAD_LINK_FLAGS)
    target_link_libraries(${name} PRIVATE ${VASP_OFFLOAD_LINK_FLAGS})
  endif()
  if(VASP_OFFLOAD_LIBS)
    target_link_libraries(${name} PRIVATE ${VASP_OFFLOAD_LIBS})
  endif()
  set_target_properties(${name} PROPERTIES LINKER_LANGUAGE Fortran)
  set_target_properties(${name} PROPERTIES Fortran_MODULE_DIRECTORY ${PREPROCESSED_DIR})
  set_target_properties(${name} PROPERTIES Fortran_FORMAT FREE)
  # include this for the .inc files
  target_include_directories(${name} PRIVATE ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/src)
  # making LIB_DIR/mod available for libraries linking LIB
  target_include_directories(${name} INTERFACE ${PREPROCESSED_DIR})
  if(NVHPC_INCLUDE)
    target_include_directories(${name} PRIVATE ${NVHPC_INCLUDE})
  endif()

  if(VASP_FFTLIB)
    target_link_libraries(vasp_std PRIVATE fftlib_objects)
  endif()
endfunction()

#--------------------------------------------
# add src files add run custom target command
#--------------------------------------------

# add all source files
set(VASP_SOURCES ${VASP_SOURCES} ${VASP_SOURCES_DEFAULT})
list(APPEND VASP_SOURCES main.F)
list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES VASP_SOURCES)

if(NOT "${VASP_SOURCES_DEB}" STREQUAL "")
  message(STATUS "for debug marked files: ${VASP_SOURCES_DEB}")
endif()

# add extra source files for the lib
if(VASP_FFTLIB)
  add_subdirectory(fftlib)
endif()
add_subdirectory(lib)
add_subdirectory(parser)

# here the add_executables are generated via the custom function
vasp_create_executable(vasp_std "${VASP_SOURCES}")
vasp_create_executable(vasp_gam "${VASP_SOURCES}")
vasp_create_executable(vasp_ncl "${VASP_SOURCES}")

if(VASP_VASPML)
  add_subdirectory(vaspml)
  foreach(_vasp_variant vasp_std vasp_gam vasp_ncl)
    target_link_libraries(${_vasp_variant} PRIVATE vaspml)
  endforeach()
endif()

install(TARGETS vasp_std DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR})
install(TARGETS vasp_gam DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR})
install(TARGETS vasp_ncl DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR})

# if no install prefix is set, use the current source dir/bin folder as in the old build system
if(CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX_INITIALIZED_TO_DEFAULT)
    set(CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/bin CACHE PATH "Default install path" FORCE)
endif()
